_help: Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the transaction description and memo.
Any rule can be limited with "sources": [scraper ids, e.g. "leumi", "visaCal"] and/or "kind": "bank" or "card".

cardBills: how each card's monthly bill appears on the bank account. If that card is scraped, the bank row is matched to the card's own charge day and dropped (the card's itemized purchases count instead); any part of the bill the card data does not itemize stays as '<label> – ללא פירוט'. If the card is not scraped, the bank row counts as spending.
cardInternal: card rows that are not purchases (e.g. a revolving-credit balance that repeats earlier purchases). They are left out entirely; the bank payment for them is still matched to the card.
ignore: rows outside the cash flow ('לא בתזרים'), e.g. savings, investments, loans received. Optional "direction": "in" (money in) or "out" (money out); without it the rule matches both.

fixed / variable: force a description into fixed or variable. Everything else is detected automatically: a charge that appears about once a month, almost every month, with a similar amount, is fixed. Installments are always fixed.
categories: first match wins and overrides the card company's category. Use it for bank rows (which have no category) and to fix wrong ones.
tracked: the category cards shown on the dashboard. Each groups one or more categories.
aliases: rename or merge categories that come from the card companies, e.g. {"מזון ומשקאות": "מזון וצריכה"}.
extraCategories: categories offered in the שינוי dialog even before any transaction uses them.

fixedGroups: how the "הוצאות קבועות" breakdown is grouped, in display order. A payee goes to the group whose name equals its category (set with שינוי), else the first group whose pattern matches its description, else the first group listing its category, else the last group.
After `npm run build`, the console lists the largest uncategorized descriptions so you know which rules to add.

cardInternal.note: a card moving unpaid purchases into revolving credit lists them again as one row; the purchases already count

ignore.note: moving money to your own savings

ignore.pattern: ^(?!.*(עמל|דמי ניהול|דמי משמרת)).*(נע-|ני"ע|ני''ע|נ"ע|ניירות ערך|קרן כספית|כספית|פדיון|רווחי? הון|דיבידנד|אג"ח|מק"מ|קנ' ני|מכ' ני)
ignore.note: securities and money-market fund (קרן כספית) buys, sells, redemptions, dividends and capital-gains tax: moving your own money, not income or spending. Securities fees stay counted.
a loan received is not income

categories.pattern: תאגיד מים|מי אביבים|מי שבע|מי רמת גן|הגיחון|מי כרמל
